description: No. of killed or seriously injured road casualties (adjusted annual) - WMCA is a dataset listed in Birmingham City Observatory open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Department for Transport. This is the number of people of all ages killed or seriously injured (KSI) in road traffic accidents, in an area, adjusted. Coverage: West Midlands Combined Authority area, including Birmingham. The portal files it under Safety, Transport. Its keywords are west midlands combined authority, wmca, road safety, deaths, west midlands police, police. The portal shows 90 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-cityobservatory-birmingham-gov-uk-portal.
